# ymfm upstream

This directory contains the minimum files required for the YM2151 (OPM) core
from [aaronsgiles/ymfm](https://github.com/aaronsgiles/ymfm).

- Commit: `81aec25ccbb98f4873a255f7551ac4dadac59b4a`
- Imported: 2026-07-30
- License: BSD 3-Clause; see `LICENSE`
- Included families: common FM engine and OPM only

The files are kept unmodified so that future upstream comparisons remain
mechanical.
